title: The Reassembled Message Reads Backwards
subject: Networks
briefing: Packets arrive out of order. The receiver must sort them by their sequence number before joining their payloads.
symptom: The output message contains every fragment, but the text is scrambled.
hints: Look at the sequence numbers in the order the receiver joins the payloads.
The sort comparator determines whether earlier or later packets come first.
Reassembly needs sequence numbers in ascending order.
